meta.title: AI Search
meta.description: Describe your ideal master's in plain language. Our AI parses it and matches against every program in the catalog.

heading: Tell us what you're looking for
intro: Describe your ideal master's in your own words — country, field, budget, timeline, anything. Our AI will translate your description into a structured profile and match it against every program in our catalog.

form.placeholder: e.g. 'I want a 2-year management masters in Italy or Spain, under €15k a year, with a year of internship experience.'
form.charsRemaining: {count, plural, one {Add at least # more character} other {Add at least # more characters}}

examples.heading: Need inspiration? Try one of these
items: I want a 2-year management masters in Italy or Spain, under €15k a year, and I have a year of internship experience.
Looking for a research-heavy AI masters in Germany or Switzerland. I'd like to do a PhD after. English is fluent.
I'm a fresh econ graduate, need scholarship, want to study finance in the Netherlands or Sweden. Plan to work in Europe after.
